chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿImrān al-ʿIjlī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
What was the place of the House when the water existed
in the saying of Allah, the Exalted: “And His Throne was upon the water”
He said: “It was a white expanse, meaning a pearl.”

key_terms.الْمَاءُ: the primordial water mentioned in the Qur’anic description
key_terms.دُرَّةً: a pearl, clarifying the nature of that white expanse
key_terms.عَرْشُهُ: His Throne, referring to Allah’s Throne in the verse
key_terms.مَهَاةً بَيْضَاءَ: a white expanse or bright white substance
key_terms.مَوْضِعُ الْبَيْتِ: the place or location of the House, meaning the Kaʿbah

ai.seo_question: What was the place of the Kaʿbah when Allah’s Throne was upon the water?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the location of al-Bayt in relation to the primordial state mentioned in the Qur’anic phrase, “And His Throne was upon the water.” Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that its place was a white expanse, explained as a pearl, indicating a pre-earthly, cosmological reality connected to the sanctity of the Kaʿbah.
